title: Verify part-sale work orders auto-resolve cores at receive while service work orders require manual Ok/Not OK
custom_preconds:
1. Signed in as Admin.
  2. A part-sale work order and a service work order, each with a cored part, exist.
custom_steps:
1. Receive the cored part on the part-sale work order and check core status.
  2. Receive the cored part on the service work order and check core status.
custom_expected:
1. On the part-sale WO the core auto-resolves at receive.
  2. On the service WO the core requires manual Ok / Not OK.
